MG3KWS.description: A belt-fed Eisenmarkian LMG with roots dating back to the MG42. Fastest fire rate, but has a 50 round magazine, lower damage, and a lengthy reload process.
MG3KWS.name: MG3KWS

L86 LSW.description:
A heavyweight squad weapon variant as part of the SA80 family!
The increased barrel length and bipod gives this weapon improved accuracy, increased muzzle velocity and greater effective range. It was withdrawn in 2019 after being confirmed the L86 would not receive further upgrades.
Increased fire rate with high damage, penetration and bullet speed but suffers from heavy weight and a slow reload time.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
L86 LSW.name: L86 LSW

RPK.description: A heavy variant of the AK47 with a more durable receiver and heavy barrel. Packs a punch, but fires slowly, with strong recoil.
RPK.name: RPK

RPK12.description:
A speculative light machine gun based off of the AK-12 pre-production variant, likely intended to replace the RPK-74. While a mockup of the gun is said to exist, there are no official images of it. It was likely abandoned in favour of the RPK-16 platform early in development.

Relatively average performance across the board.

Model submitted by Rialag
RPK12.name: RPK12

M27 IAR.description:
A much ruggedized variant of the Eisenmarkian M416 adopted by Grand Federation in role of a Squad Automatic Weapon issued to troops.
Sustainable firerate with manageable accuracy due to a heavier barrel and extra reserve ammo, but also suffers from lower-than-average power and magazine size in class.
''I have been trained by your Government to be a weapon. Trained to kill and destroy. All in the name of Liberty and Justice.''

Model submitted by Rialag.
M27 IAR.name: M27 IAR

attachmentModifiers.info:
A larger 60 round drum magazine!
Doubles your magazine capacity at the cost of handling, mobility and reload time!

GOLDEN HK51B.description: A special variant of the LMG BLING from a crystal like material that makes it bling in beauty! Uses .308 Winchester as stock ammo but the casings can be filled with many types of gemstones with each having special unique effects! Which gemstone will you main?
GOLDEN HK51B.name: GOLDEN HK51B

MGV-176.description:
A Slovenian modernization of the Grand Federation 180. Chambered in .22LR and with a mag size of 161, this weapon fires accurately at an excruciating high fire rate. Although, with its mediocre damage values, its insane rate of fire more than makes up for it.
Make anyone you shoot yell out 'No, Not the Bees!?!!'
MGV-176.name: MGV-176

PKP.description:
A further modification of the Zarovian PKM.
Uses a heavier, partially forced-air-cooled barrel with radial cooling ribs to keep the barrel cooler while having an increased fire rate.
High damage with a fast fire rate but difficult to control.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
PKP.name: PKP

AK12BR.description:
The AK-12BR (for "Balanced Recoil") is a 5.45x39mm AK-12 prototype using a BARS system and a highly unconventional 'snail' drum magazine. No known development of the AK-12s with BARS exists, and the AK-12 prototypes were abandoned long before any such development could've taken place. 

High rate of fire and incredible gun stability, but very low damage.

Model submitted by Rialag
AK12BR.name: AK12BR

RPK74.description: An updated variant of the RPK based off the AK74, intended to use the less powerful 5.45x39mm cartridge for greater recoil control and better performance overall.
RPK74.name: RPK74
